name: Skipper Angus

intro.text: I run the boat out to Inchcolm. Abbey, seals, puffins if you're lucky, and me telling you about the abbey, the seals and the puffins whether you're lucky or not.

win: Aye, you've got your sea legs right enough.
after: Inchcolm Abbey was founded after a king was shipwrecked there and a hermit fed him on shellfish for three days. Alexander the First. He was very grateful. Or very full.
